p: The Hoshana for the Ushpiza of Moshe
the first day, the Ushpiza of Avraham:
for he fulfilled the entire Torah
יוֹם שֵׁנִי אֶבֶן שְׁתִיָּה, בֵּית הַבְּחִירָה,
which is the Ushpiza of Yitzchak,
is called "the first of the converts" (Chagigah 3a).
for he became a native in Yisrael,
and he too was called by the name Yisrael
מִכָּל מָקוֹם עַד שֶׁלֹּא נוֹלַד יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ
nevertheless, until Yaakov Avinu was born
he is called "the first of the converts";
which is not so of Yitzchak, Yaakov's father,
"And Yitzchak went out to meditate in the field" —
at the site of the Beis HaMikdash.
they recognized the place of the altar
And on the third day we say
corresponding to Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom,
who built a house in Yisrael,
who brought down holiness to Yisrael.
brought down the words of Torah to Yisrael,
וְלֵית לָךְ מִלָּה לְתַבְּרָא יֵצֶר הָרָע
and "there is nothing that breaks the yetzer hara
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר חֵלֶק א רב, א).
besides You there is none to save,"
along the lines of what Chazal said
from the accusation of the yetzer hara.
all the days of the festival
"If I am a master, where is My fear?"
And as we said on Shabbos Teshuvah,
that even through the lower teshuvah, out of fear,
which is from the last attribute —
and "the Shabbos of the eve of Shabbos:
she is fear, and fear rests in her"
one also merits the higher teshuvah
up to the Throne of Glory (Yoma 86a),
which includes all the nine attributes
and "the upper tip alludes to Ayin"
And Sukkos is the time of the war of Gog and Magog
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב הַטּוּר אוֹרַח חַיִּים סִימָן תצ
in the name of Rav Hai Gaon).
"In Tishrei they will be redeemed" (Rosh Hashanah 11a)
in the passage beginning "Come and see":
are a halachah l'Moshe miSinai, etc.
The place that is called Mount Sinai,
"And then they will perform the water libation,
'For the earth shall be full of knowledge
as the waters cover the sea' (Yeshayah 11:9)."
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
according to what is said in the holy Zohar
(דִּבּוּר הַמַּתְחִיל וְתָא חֲזֵי בְּהַאי חַגָּא וְכוּלֵּי):
(in the passage beginning "And come and see, on this festival," etc.):
that flow forth from the upper, hidden Yerushalayim."
For Yerushalayim is Malchus, the mouth,
the Torah she'b'al peh, the lower wisdom;
that was hidden away for the tzaddikim for the time to come,
which is the upper tip of the yud
of Rabbi Akiva and his colleagues —
כָּל יְקָר רָאֲתָה עֵינוֹ (אִיּוֹב כח, י),
"Every precious thing his eye has seen" (Iyov 28:10):
"this is Rabbi Akiva and his colleagues"
and according to their own intellect and understanding.
וְעַל זֶה אָמְרוּ (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא יב, ב):
And about this they said (Bava Basra 12b):
But when he arrives at the true conclusion
and a halachah l'Moshe miSinai is stated in accordance with him,
For this only Moshe Rabbeinu merited,
And these are "a halachah without a reason"
And although there is a reason,
it is only like Rabbi Shimon,
who expounds the reason of the verse
but in truth they are decrees.
And this only Moshe Rabbeinu merited,
who was humbler than any man.
"And wisdom — from where shall it be found?"
meaning that his wisdom came from Ayin,
which is the hidden holy Atika,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב סד, ב),
And this is the crown of the yud,
which is the light that was hidden away.
that flow forth from the upper, hidden Yerushalayim":
the hidden light, the tip of the yud;
and its tip is the light that was hidden away,
And this was merited only "from Sinai,"
בַּסְּנֶה, לָאו מִשּׁוּם דִּגְבִיהַת מִכָּל אִילָנֵי
of the bush: "Not because you are taller than all trees
אַשְׁרֵי קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא שְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ עֲלָךְ,
did the Holy One, blessed be He, rest His Shechinah upon you,
אֶלָּא מִשּׁוּם דְּמַיְיכַת מִכָּל אִילָנֵי וְכוּלֵּי
but because you are lower than all trees," etc.
that the Holy One, blessed be He, is destined to do,
when the Holy One, blessed be He, will remove
when pure living waters will descend
And this is what is said:
And it concludes: "Then it is written (Yeshayah 12:3):
'And you shall draw water with joy
which pour forth into this salvation," etc.
And this is why we say "Adon HaMoshia," etc.
And likewise, his sefirah is Netzach.
And it is stated in the Gemara (Berachos 58a):
this is the downfall of the wicked nation,"
for in it will come the defeat of Gog and Magog.
And in the Midrash Rabbah (Vayikra Rabbah 30:2),
"Pleasantness is at Your right hand forever":
"Whoever takes the palm branches in his hand,
we know that they are the victors," etc.
